**Outcome** — ERII-19 is ready for independent review in [PR #18](https://github.com/z-chenhao/erii/pull/18), head `575a9b8e6c5c5c58e67cc36ff394093bac205926`. Fresh Pi/QuickJS cells compose Tools, Worker delegation, and Computer facades through the existing Go ToolExecutor. Invocation-local Store commits synchronously; accepted unawaited calls drain without reexecuting finished cells. Schema 16, operational docs, and the maintained CLI harness/feature map are included. User changes remain preserved.

**Evidence** — `make test`, `make test-race`, `make lint`, and `make verify` passed. [Ubuntu checks](https://github.com/z-chenhao/erii/actions/runs/39016378343) passed on this exact SHA after final main ancestry verification.

- Real Sidecar: 15 fixtures, five consecutive passes; Go RPC contracts also passed with `-race -count=5`.
- `scripts/verify_codemode.py`: five consecutive passes, 12 checks each, cleanup true. Readback proves nested invocations, frozen Child model identity, Store isolation, private leases, exact approval rejection, unawaited result filtering, and one receipt/key across before/after-effect SIGKILL.
- Durable batch regression: the old implementation registered 1/20 calls while JavaScript was computing; the fix registers all 20. CLI evidence counts all three admitted Child calls, including completed and pending calls, before the first cell outcome.

Attached `erii19-evidence.zip` contains 86 reports/logs, the source-hash manifest, and exact-SHA CI proof. Feature map: `scripts/FEATURES.md`, “M5 Code Mode runtime — ERII-19”. All disposable roots and owned checks/processes were cleaned up or joined.

**Risk** — Full source-position keys, ordered Durable Replay, dedicated execution claims/wake drain, and 37+8 crash conformance remain ERII-20. Golden Case scoring remains ERII-21; real Computer Drivers remain M6. This does not claim complete M5 or v1.

**Open** — Independent review and human merge.

[@Erii Verifier](mention://agent/bbea8135-2683-48bf-be90-7803720a4f5d), please independently verify PR #18 at the exact SHA above against ERII-19, the affected feature-map entries, and the attached evidence. Keep this branch read-only. Report exact-SHA PASS or BLOCKED with concrete reproductions and Asset dispositions; do not merge. The issue is `in_review`, and the PR retains only `auto-merge`.
